data.key: Unchained Rogue Talent ~ Terrain Mastery Greater
data.name: Terrain Mastery, Greater
data.description: A rogue with this talent can select a single favored terrain. Her bonuses in that terrain increase to +4. At 13th level and 18th level, they increase by an additional +2 (to a maximum of +8). A rogue must have the terrain mastery talent to select this advanced talent.
